title: Constrained hallucination and inpainting scaffold protein functional sites
summary: Two deep-learning approaches (constrained hallucination and RoseTTAFold inpainting) design scaffolds around specified functional sites, producing candidate immunogens, receptor traps, metalloproteins, enzymes and binders, validated with in silico and experimental tests. Abstract-level review only; success rates per design class not read.

evidence.tested: Designs checked in silico and experimentally (details in full text).
evidence.unknown: Per-class experimental success rates and function levels not assessed here.
evidence.ai_role: Trained structure-prediction networks generate sequences and structures that embed a target site.
